show.description: Dabang Daddy follows the turbulent life of Ram Kumar, a principled architect betrayed by fate, as he clashes with his greedy stepson Jacky, manipulative wife Maya, and ambitious daughter-in-law Richa. When corporate tycoon Miss Tanya Malhotra offers Ram a second chance at success, greed, betrayal, and hidden truths threaten to tear apart his family. A gripping tale of love, deceit, and the true cost of money. Watch Now!
